name: comp-231
blurb: Searchable timezone picker with Intl offsets.
description: A searchable combobox for all supported timezones with GMT offsets. Uses Intl API and custom search filter.
use_when: Users need to find a timezone quickly from a long list.
avoid_when: Short timezone lists or non-searchable layouts.
a11y: Combobox role; keyboard navigable; timezone names are clear.
